visualCharacteristics: Full-width band with autoplaying muted looping background video (Vimeo) behind overlay text; text white, either right-aligned H1 (top hero) or centered large statement.
contentPattern: Full-width background video with headline: a hero; video background belongs to the block, so the section is not styled. | Statement text over an autoplaying background video (visual tree reports #000 only because the video is painted over a black container); background media belongs to the hero block, so no section style.
usage: Full-width band with an autoplaying, muted, looping background video (Vimeo, YouTube or MP4) behind a headline or statement.
reuseGuidance: Use for heroes or statement bands whose background is a video. Author the video URL as a plain link in the text; it is removed from the text and rendered as background media. An optional image acts as poster/fallback. For a photo background, use hero-banner.

cells: Background image (optional; for background-video heroes use the poster image and keep the Vimeo URL as a link in the text cell)
Rich text: title (heading), subheading/paragraph, CTA link
